title: White Chocolate Caramel Ripple Brownie
desc: A rich round brownie studded with soft caramel and white chocolate.
steps: Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs individually, then melted chocolate. Briefly mix in dry ingredients and water. Fold in chopped caramels and white chocolate.
Spread in a lined, greased 24–26 cm round tin. Bake at 175°C for about 40 minutes. Cool in the tin for 2–3 hours before lifting out.
Melt caramels with cream over medium heat, stirring until smooth. Drizzle across the cooled brownie.

title: Hidden Caramel Pocket Brownies
desc: Caramel-filled chocolates tucked inside a dark brownie slab.
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time, followed by vanilla and melted chocolate. Briefly mix in dry ingredients and water.

Line a 30×40 cm tray. Spread in half the batter, scatter over caramel chocolates and cover with remaining batter. Bake at 175°C for 35–40 minutes, until a tester has moist crumbs rather than wet batter. Cool before cutting.
Whip cream with chocolate drink powder and serve alongside.

title: Midnight Cookie Sandwich Squares
desc: Fudgy chocolate squares with a concealed layer of sandwich cookies.
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla, then melted chocolate. Fold in dry ingredients and water without overmixing.

Spread half into a lined, greased 20×20 cm tin. Arrange the cookies in an even layer and cover with remaining batter. Bake at 175°C for about 40 minutes, until a tester carries moist crumbs. Cool in the tin, then cut into squares.

title: Mint Meadow Chocolate Squares
desc: Three layers of brownie, peppermint frosting and a crisp chocolate finish.
ferment: Cool; chill frosting 30 min; chill until set
steps: Melt chocolate and butter. Whisk eggs, sugar and vanilla for 2 minutes; gently mix in chocolate, then flour and baking powder. Bake in a lined 20×30 cm tin at 180°C for 20–30 minutes. Cool.
Beat frosting ingredients until light; tint if desired. Spread over the brownie and chill 30 minutes.
Melt chocolate with butter and cool for about 20 minutes, stirring. Spread over frosting, add optional chocolate thins and refrigerate until set before slicing.

title: Silky Double Chocolate Brownies
desc: Mayonnaise adds moisture to these tender double-chocolate brownies.
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and cocoa together. Whisk eggs, sugar and vanilla until pale and thick; mix in melted chocolate. Fold in the dry mixture, mayonnaise and chocolate chips.
Spread in a lined, greased 23×23 cm tin. Bake at 160°C for about 45 minutes, until a tester has crumbs but no wet batter. Cool in the tin before lifting out and cutting.

title: Ganache-Topped Caramel Treasure Bars
desc: White chocolate and caramel pockets beneath a smooth ganache layer.
ferment: Cool completely; chill ganache until set
steps: Melt butter and dark chocolate gently. Whisk eggs and sugar until pale; fold in chocolate mixture, then flour. Spread in a lined 20×30 cm tin and scatter halved caramel chocolates and white chips over it. Bake at 150°C for about 35 minutes; cool completely.

Pour hot cream over chopped chocolate. Wait 5 minutes, then stir smooth. Cool about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Spread over the cold brownie, chill until set and cut; decorate with extra chocolates if desired.

title: Classic Deep Chocolate Brownie Bites
desc: A simple, chewy brownie with a rich dark chocolate centre.
steps: Cream butter and sugar until light. Beat in eggs and vanilla, then melted chocolate. Briefly fold in flour, cocoa, salt and water.

Spread in a lined, greased 20×20 cm tin. Bake at 175°C for about 40 minutes, until a tester has a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter. Rest briefly in the tin, then lift out and cool fully, about 1 hour, before cutting.

title: Pecan Caramel Mosaic Brownies
desc: Pecans and white chocolate surround a thick caramel layer.
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs individually, then vanilla. Gently fold in flour, cocoa and salt.

Reserve about 1 cup of batter per batch; spread the rest in a lined 25×25 cm tin. Scatter pecans and white chips on top, followed by caramel. Fold dark chips into the reserved batter and spread it over the caramel.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes. Cool at least 2 hours before cutting. Dust with icing sugar if desired.

title: Sweet-and-Salty Cracker Brownies
desc: Salted cracker sandwiches give these shortcut brownies a savoury crunch.
ingredients: Extra ingredients required by the brownie-mix package
Neutral oil, additional to package directions
steps: Sandwich the crackers in pairs with the spread, using 1 teaspoon per pair at the base scale.

Prepare the mix using its package ingredients, then add the extra oil. Spread half into a lined, greased 20×20 cm tin. Arrange cracker sandwiches in an even layer and scatter over nuts and chips; cover with remaining batter.
Bake at 160°C for 25 minutes. Cool in the tin for at least 1 hour before cutting.

title: Peppermint Truffle Frosted Brownies
desc: Mint-filled chocolates baked into cocoa brownies with fluffy frosting.
steps: Cream butter with both sugars. Beat in eggs individually and vanilla. Mix flour, cocoa and baking powder, then fold into the batter with chopped mint chocolates. Bake in a greased 20×30 cm tin at 175°C for about 35 minutes. Cool.
Beat butter, cocoa, icing sugar, vanilla and milk until fluffy. Spread over the cold brownie. Cut and decorate with mint chocolates and optional fresh mint.

title: Celebration Letter Brownie
desc: A firm brownie canvas for a personalised letter or number cake.
steps: Melt butter and chocolate; cool slightly. Whisk eggs and sugar until pale; slowly mix in chocolate. Fold in sifted flour, cocoa and salt, then white chips.

Spread in a lined, greased oven tray. Bake at 180°C for about 25 minutes. Cool completely, then refrigerate until firm. Use a paper template to cut out a letter; remove the template before decorating. Tray dimensions are unspecified.
Beat butter and cream cheese. Add salt and both vanilla ingredients, then icing sugar gradually. Pipe over the brownie and decorate.

title: Hazelnut Orchard Fudge Squares
desc: Whole hazelnuts and fruit-studded chocolate enrich these frosted squares.
ingredients: Dark chocolate with hazelnuts and currants
steps: Melt butter and both chocolates over a water bath. Whisk eggs with both sugars until pale; mix in chocolate. Fold in flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt, then vanilla and hazelnuts.
Spread in a lined, greased 20×30 cm tin. Bake at 160°C for about 40 minutes, until a tester has crumbs rather than wet batter. Cool completely.
Spread hazelnut chocolate over the brownie and scatter extra nuts on top. Add more spread if preferred, then slice.

title: Spring Bunny Brownie Celebration Cake
desc: A brownie bunny topped with chocolate cream-cheese frosting and candy eggs.
steps: Melt butter and chocolate; cool slightly. Whisk eggs and sugar until pale, then slowly mix in chocolate. Fold in sifted flour, cocoa and salt, followed by chopped chocolate eggs.

Spread in a lined, greased deep oven tray. Bake at 180°C for about 30 minutes, until a tester has moist crumbs. Cool fully, then cut a bunny shape using a paper template. Tray and package sizes are unspecified.
Beat butter, cream cheese and vanilla. Gradually beat in cocoa, icing sugar and salt. Pipe over the cake.
Finish with biscuit fingers, chocolate eggs and optional edible flowers.

title: Toasted Marshmallow Caramel Brownies
desc: Gooey marshmallow and caramel crunch top a dense cocoa brownie.
steps: Melt butter and mix with brown sugar. Beat in eggs individually, then vanilla; fold in flour, cocoa and salt. Spread in a lined, greased 25×25 cm tin and bake at 170°C for about 30 minutes, until a tester has moist crumbs.

Scatter marshmallows, chips and caramel clusters over the brownie. Set the oven grill to 200°C and return the tin for about 5 minutes, watching continuously until the marshmallows lightly brown. Cool before lifting out and slicing.

title: Toffee Cookie Crumble Brownies
desc: Almond-toffee chocolate brownies beneath a dark cookie-crumb topping.
ingredients: Milk chocolate with almond toffee pieces
steps: Melt butter and dark chocolate with three-fifths of the toffee chocolate. Chop and reserve the rest. Mix brown sugar and vanilla into the melted mixture, then add eggs individually. Fold in flour and reserved chocolate.
Spread in a lined, greased 25×25 cm tin.
Scatter cookie crumbs over the batter. Bake at 160°C for 35–40 minutes, until a tester has moist crumbs but no wet batter. Cool completely before lifting out and cutting.

title: Evergreen Frosted Brownie Cake
desc: A shortcut brownie cake decorated with green vanilla frosting.
steps: Mix eggs, oil, water and cocoa, then stir in brownie mix. Spread in a greased tray or tree-shaped tin. Bake at 160°C for 30–35 minutes, until a tester has moist crumbs. Cool completely and cut into a tree if needed. Package and tray sizes are unspecified.
Cover the sides, trunk and a narrow upper border with chocolate frosting. Beat vanilla frosting with icing sugar and tint green. Pipe over the remaining surface and add sprinkles.

title: Blueberry Toffee Glazed Brownies
desc: Nougat-chocolate brownies with a soft toffee glaze and blueberries.
ferment: Cool completely; chill glaze until set
steps: Melt butter and dark chocolate; cool slightly. Whisk eggs and sugar until pale, then slowly mix in melted chocolate. Fold in sifted flour, cocoa and salt, followed by chopped nougat chocolate. Bake in a lined, greased 25×25 cm tin at 180°C for about 40 minutes. Cool fully.
Melt candies with cream over medium heat, stirring until smooth. Spread over the cooled brownie while still in its tin; chill until the glaze thickens.
Lift out, cut into squares and finish with blueberries and icing sugar.

title: Liquorice Fudge Brownies with Vanilla Cream
desc: Easy chocolate-fudge squares with liquorice pieces and double-vanilla cream.
steps: Mix egg, oil, water and cocoa. Stir in cake mix and fold in chopped liquorice fudge. Spread in a lined, greased 25×25 cm tin. Bake at 160°C for 22–25 minutes; cool before cutting into 16 pieces.
Whip cream, icing sugar, vanilla seeds and extract to firm peaks. Serve with the brownies and fresh berries.

title: Triple Chocolate Wafer Surprise Bars
desc: Cream-filled wafers hidden inside a brownie packed with three chocolates.
ingredients: Extra dark, milk and white chocolate chips
steps: Cream butter with both sugars. Beat in eggs and vanilla, then melted chocolate. Briefly mix in flour, cocoa, salt and water; fold in the three kinds of chips.

Spread half into a lined 20×20 cm tin. Arrange wafers with small gaps, cover with remaining batter and scatter extra wafers and chips on top. Bake at 175°C for 35 minutes, loosely covering with foil for the first 20 minutes. Cool and cut.

title: Berry Velvet Sherry-Cream Brownie
desc: A chocolate pudding brownie topped with sherry-scented cream and berries.
steps: Mix pudding powder, flour, baking soda and salt. Whisk melted butter, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla separately; gently combine with the dry ingredients and fold in chips. Bake in a lined, greased 20 cm tin at 180°C for 22–25 minutes. Cool completely. The pudding-packet weight is unspecified.
Whip cream with sherry and icing sugar until firm. Spread over the cold brownie and arrange berries on top.

title: Golden Pecan Caramel Brownie Squares
desc: A thin brownie layer finished with bubbling caramel and chopped pecans.
steps: Melt butter with chocolate; cool slightly. Whisk eggs and sugar until pale, then mix in chocolate and vanilla. Fold in flour and salt. Spread in a lined, greased 23×23 cm tin and bake at 175°C for 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, melt brown sugar, butter and cream in a saucepan. Boil for 1 minute, stirring. Scatter pecans over the partly baked brownie and pour on the caramel. Bake another 10–12 minutes, until the edges darken slightly. Cool before slicing; serve with optional ice cream.

title: Cocoa Mascarpone Berry Brownie
desc: Coffee-enriched brownie with whipped cocoa mascarpone and fresh berries.
steps: Cream butter with both sugars. Beat in eggs, then melted chocolate and coffee. Fold in vanilla sugar, cocoa and flour. Bake in a lined, greased 20×20 cm tin at 170°C for about 35 minutes, until a tester has moist crumbs. Cool completely and lift out.
Beat mascarpone with icing sugar and cocoa. Slowly add cream, whipping only until thick and spreadable. Spread over the cold brownie.
Finish with sliced strawberries, raspberries and toffee pieces.

title: Caramel-Liquorice Brownie Warmers
desc: Caramel chocolate and liquorice pieces combine in a warm dessert brownie.
ingredients: Milk chocolate with liquorice pieces, chopped
steps: Melt butter with both kinds of chocolate chips. Mix in brown sugar and vanilla, then eggs individually. Fold in flour and chopped liquorice chocolate. Spread in a lined, greased 25×25 cm tin and bake at 160°C for about 35 minutes.
Melt chewy candies with cream, stirring until smooth. Let the brownie cool enough to slice, then serve warm pieces with whipped cream, strawberries and the sauce.

title: Glossy Fudge Bistro Cake
desc: A dense chocolate cake with a glossy cooked fudge glaze.
ferment: Cool cake; cool glaze about 20 min; chill until set
steps: Melt butter and chocolate; cool slightly. Whisk eggs and sugar, slowly mix in chocolate, then briefly fold in dry ingredients. Bake in a lined, greased round tin at 175°C: about 50 minutes for 22 cm, or 40–45 minutes for 24 cm. Cool completely.

Bring butter, sugar, cocoa, syrup and cream to a boil while stirring. Reduce heat and stir until sugar dissolves. Add chopped chocolate and stir smooth. Cool about 20 minutes until thick, spread over the cake and chill until set.
Finish with berries and serve with whipped cream.
